title: Fox Tells 5,000+ PAN Youth in Aguascalientes: Unite to 'partirle la madre a Morena' in 2027
detail: A day after meeting PRI leadership, Fox addresses more than 5,000 young PAN members at the National Youth Action Encounter in Aguascalientes, calling the 2027 midterm congressional election 'la madre de todas las batallas' (the mother of all battles) for Mexico's future. Fox argues opposition forces do not need to agree on everything — 'no necesariamente vamos a escoger con los que más simpatizamos... con eso basta para superar todas las demás divisiones' — only enough to unite in a single effort against Morena, and says that if the opposition cannot win the presidency, Congress should at least remain 'bien resguardado' by lawmakers who believe in democracy and freedom. The speech prompts President Claudia Sheinbaum to dismiss the Fox-PRI overture the next day as an attempt to 'regresar al pasado' of corruption and privilege.
